message:
The build environment is isolated - it doesn't have access to `/workspace`. Let me check what's available in the build environment:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'ls / && echo "---" && ls /gt 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && find / -name "mruby" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -5'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
